scripts.render:build: npm ci && npm run build -w shared && npm run build -w server
scripts.pages:build: npm run build -w shared && npm run build -w client
scripts.build: npm run build -w shared && npm run build -w server && npm run build -w client
scripts.dev: npm run build -w shared && concurrently -n shared,server,client -c blue,green,magenta "npm run dev -w shared" "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.dev:quick: concurrently -n server,client -c green,magenta "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.dev:stable: npm run build -w shared && npm run dev:quick
